GOST_tests.domain: The exact 33 uppercase Russian letters in the frozen manifest; no punctuation, padding, case normalization or word boundaries.
GOST_tests.enumeration_order: length then itertools.product in the manifest dictionary alphabet order; order is not a historical cipher key
GOST_tests.fixed_substitution_scope: A fixed function maps each individual transport output character to one output symbol, followed by an arbitrary permutation. It does NOT act on complete variable-length Cyrillic codewords.
GOST_tests.synthetic_controls: separate quote markers; hard sign is not two soft signs; ambiguous toy code rejected; unknown input rejected; full-code re-encoding equality

Shavian_tests.source: Kingsley Read, July 1963, Guide to Shavian Spelling; source-review receipt, pages 1-4
Shavian_tests.transport_encoding: not specified in inspected historical material; do not invent one
Shavian_tests.conclusion_scope: Necessary feasibility bounds and missing operational model; not exclusion of all Shavian or language layers.

null_rationale: Exact code inversion and support/parity arguments are deterministic within declared assumptions; no ranking or language score.
